name: JJC8-016
summary: JJC8-016 is an atypical dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI) derived from modafinil. It was an early lead in the development of novel modafinil analogues with improved properties for potential use in the treatment of psychostimulant use disorder (PSUD).

pharmacology.text: The affinities of JJC8-016 for the monoamine transporters are 114 nM for the dopamine transporter (DAT), 3850 nM for the norepinephrine transporter (NET) (34-fold lower than for the DAT), and 354 nM for the serotonin transporter (SERT) (3.1-fold lower than for the DAT).
